question.:question/problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $p=⟨2,2,3⟩,$ $q=⟨4,2,-1⟩,$ and $r=⟨-5,0,3⟩.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}p\cdot (q\times r) & =|\begin{aligned}2 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \\ -5 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -5 & 3\end{aligned}|+3\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -5 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(2\cdot 3-0\cdot (-1))-2(4\cdot 3-(-5)\cdot (-1))+3(4\cdot 0-(-5)\cdot 2) \\  & =12-14+30 \\  & =28\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|28|=28.
$$
